Class Fonts

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.ui.fonts.Fonts
public final class Fonts extends Object
Centralized font factory for MDI.

Under FlatLaf the canonical "common" font is the LookAndFeel default font (UI key "defaultFont"). This class derives every application font from that base so typography stays consistent across platforms and themes.

The named fonts form a size ladder expressed as point deltas from the base UI size, so they track the platform/theme default rather than using hard-coded absolute sizes: 

  monster (+8) > huge (+5) > large (+2) > bigger (+1) > default (0)
    > medium (-1) > tween (-2) > small (-3) > tiny (-4)
with bold/italic variants derived at the same sizes. Monospaced fonts follow a parallel ladder built on Font.MONOSPACED.

Call refresh() once after installing FlatLaf, and again after any theme switch, to (re)populate the named fonts. The named fields are intended to be read on the Swing event dispatch thread.

  • Method Details

    • refresh

      public static void refresh()
      Refresh the named fonts from the current LookAndFeel.

      Clears the derived-font cache and rebuilds every named font relative to the current base UI size. Call this after installing FlatLaf and again after any theme switch.
